variants.headline: We and {{partner}} agree to exchange embassies
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have agreed to exchange embassies. Each can now open a mission in the other's capital. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: An exchange of embassies with {{partner}}
body: Letters from the foreign office confirm that an exchange of embassies has been arranged with {{partner}}. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} A resident envoy in each capital will give both courts a direct channel for official business.

variants.headline: We agree to an embassy from {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has given {{partner}} permission to open an embassy in our capital. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: {{partner}} agrees to our embassy
body: {{partner}} has given our {{terms.civic.government}} permission to open an embassy in its capital. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: A research agreement with {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have signed a research agreement. Both sides stand to benefit from the research they carry out while it lasts. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: A purchase of {{weGet}} closes with {{partner}}
body: The {{player.civic.government}} has acquired a technology from {{partner}}. We provide {{weGive}}, and {{partner}} provides {{weGet}}.

variants.headline: Technology sold to {{partner}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} has sold {{weGive}} to {{partner}} for {{weGet}}. The deal is complete and envoys have confirmed the terms.

variants.headline: Technology exchange completed with {{partner}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} has exchanged technology with {{partner}}. The terms read: {{dealTerms}}. The {{terms.civic.government}} confirms the transfer is underway.

variants.headline: A technology gift from {{partner}}
body: {{partner}} has made our {{terms.civic.government}} a gift of knowledge. The terms read: {{dealTerms}}. Our educational scholars are busy preparing a new school curriculum.

variants.headline: A technology gift for {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has made {{partner}} a gift of knowledge. The terms read: {{dealTerms}}. Our scholars and translators are busy preparing materials to finalize this arrangement.

variants.headline: A new map purchased from {{partner}}
body: Our {{player.civic.government}} have bought a map from {{partner}} for {{weGive}}. Cartographers and harbor masters in {{terms.civilization}} are examining it with their own charts. In a few days, {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} bookstores will start selling the new map.

variants.headline: Cartographic sale agreed with {{partner}}
body: A map deal with {{partner}} is complete. The terms read: {{dealTerms}}. In {{terms.civilization}}, merchants are checking the new charts before the next voyage.

variants.headline: Map exchange with {{partner}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} and {{partner}} have exchanged maps. We provide {{weGive}}. {{partner}} provides {{weGet}}. Cartographers are comparing both sets of charts.

variants.headline: A gift of charts from {{partner}}
body: We have received a world map from {{partner}}, given freely and without terms. {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} cartographers and harbor masters are comparing it with their charts.  Scholars are still debating about the existence of these places.

variants.headline: We gifted a world map to {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has made {{partner}} a gift of maps. Merchants and scholars in {{terms.civilization}} will now gain our knowledge of distant coasts and roads.

triggerSummary: We signed a deal with several distinct commitments. The package can contain terms from one or both sides.

variants.headline: Bilateral agreement reached with {{partner}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} and {{partner}} have concluded a series of agreements. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: One-sided agreement signed with {{partner}}
body: A comprehensive set of terms has been agreed upon between {{terms.civilization}} and {{partner}}. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: The clauses agreed with {{partner}}
body: The foreign office has issued the terms of its agreement with {{partner}}. Several matters were settled under the same seal. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: New agreement reached with {{partner}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} and {{partner}} have signed a specific diplomatic contract: {{dealTerms}}
